Current snappi multidut test cases took too long to run. #### How did you do it? 1. Use `rand_lossless_prio/rand_lossy_prio` instead of `enum_dut_lossless_prio/enum_dut_lossy_prio` in the reboot test cases. This is the same method used in the existing T0/T1 snappi test cases. 2.
